terminals.name: web
terminals.command: cd /workspace && DATABASE_URL=stub DIRECT_URL=stub NEXTAUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000 NEXTAUTH_SECRET="$(openssl rand -base64 32)" DEV_FAKE_ADMIN=true PUBLIC_PICKS_ENABLED=true DEMO_PICKS_ENABLED=true npm run dev
terminals.description: Next.js dev server (Galaxy Sports Edge web app) on http://localhost:3000 in stub-DB mode. No Postgres or secrets required: DATABASE_URL=stub uses the built-in @sports/db stub client, DEV_FAKE_ADMIN=true grants a synthetic ADMIN session so /cockpit renders, and DEMO_PICKS_ENABLED serves deterministic sample picks (always PENDING). NEXTAUTH_SECRET is generated per boot.
